capital_invested_inr_quote: The venture started with capital expenditure of Rs 6.5 lakh in kitchen setup.
monthly_cost_inr_quote: Monthly cash burn averaged Rs 1.1 lakh covering kitchen rental and aggregator commissions.
profit_or_loss_inr_quote: The kitchen wound down operations having incurred net losses of Rs 4.5 lakh.
what_worked: Consistent packaging retained recurring weekend orders
what_failed: Delivery aggregator commission fees of 28% eroded gross margins
Customer acquisition cost on ad platforms increased threefold
own_summary: A delivery-only commercial kitchen in Mumbai ceased operations after 14 months. Rising customer acquisition costs and food delivery aggregator commissions led to net losses of 4.5 lakh INR on a 6.5 lakh INR starting capital.
